source: PAU POP Rabi 2025-26 p.9-10: full P and K (and N if SSP-sourced) drilled at sowing
timing_hint: Drill all the phosphorus and potash at sowing. With DAP no urea is needed at sowing.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Rabi 2025-26, Vol. 42, wheat 'Time and Method of Fertilizer Application'

source: PAU POP Rabi 2025-26 p.9-10 names 'first irrigation' as the first nitrogen split but does not state an exact DAS window in this source
timing_hint: Broadcast urea with the first irrigation.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Rabi 2025-26, Vol. 42, wheat 'Time and Method of Fertilizer Application'

source: PAU POP Rabi 2025-26 p.10: '2nd split of nitrogen application must be completed within 50-55 days after sowing'
timing_hint: Broadcast urea with the second irrigation, finished by 55 days after sowing. If water stands in the field, spray 7.5% urea solution (15 kg urea in 200 litres of water per acre) at 42 and 54 days after sowing instead of broadcasting.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Rabi 2025-26, Vol. 42, wheat 'Time and Method of Fertilizer Application'

source: PAU POP Rabi 2025-26 p.1-3: recommended variety maturity range is 146-158 days (e.g. PBW 872 matures in 152 days)
PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.4: optimum nursery sowing window is 20 May-20 June depending on variety
PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.5: seedlings ready for transplanting in 25-30 days (up to 45+ days under forced delay)
timing_hint: Apply all the phosphorus and potash before puddling. Phosphorus can be top-dressed up to 21 days after transplanting.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, rice fertilizer notes

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.10: 'first split should be applied upto 7 days of transplanting' -- stage is measured in Days After Transplanting (DAT), not days after sowing; see data-dictionary.md note | Days now filled from the same PAU text: 1 to 7 days after transplanting (DAT).
timing_hint: First nitrogen split: within 7 days of transplanting.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, rice fertilizer notes

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.10: second split at 21 days after transplanting (DAT, not DAS -- see data-dictionary.md note)
timing_hint: Second nitrogen split: 21 days after transplanting. Apply when water is not standing in the field and irrigate on the third day.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, rice fertilizer notes

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.10: third split at 42 DAT for most varieties, 35 DAT for short-duration PR 126 (DAT, not DAS -- see data-dictionary.md note)
timing_hint: Third nitrogen split: 42 days after transplanting (35 days for PR 126). Apply when water is not standing in the field and irrigate on the third day.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, rice fertilizer notes

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.33: one-third N plus full P and K drilled at sowing
timing_hint: Drill one-third of the nitrogen and all the phosphorus and potash at sowing.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, maize 'Time and method of application'

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.33: 'top dress one-third of nitrogen at the knee-high stage' -- exact DAS window not stated in this source
timing_hint: Top-dress one-third of the nitrogen at the knee-high stage.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, maize 'Time and method of application'

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.33: 'remaining one-third at the pre tasseling stage' -- exact DAS window not stated in this source
timing_hint: Top-dress the last one-third of the nitrogen at the pre-tasseling stage.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, maize 'Time and method of application'

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.46: sowing window is 1 April-15 May; full phosphorus drilled at sowing
timing_hint: Drill all the phosphorus at sowing. On soil low in fertility the first half of the nitrogen may go on at sowing.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, cotton fertilizer notes

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.49: 'apply half nitrogen at thinning' -- exact DAS not stated in this source
timing_hint: Apply half the nitrogen at thinning.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, cotton fertilizer notes

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.52: squares (flower buds) appear 45-55 days after sowing (pink bollworm mating-disruption timing reference)
PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.49: 'remaining half [nitrogen] at the appearance of flowers' -- exact DAS not stated in this source
timing_hint: Apply the remaining half of the nitrogen when flowers appear.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, cotton fertilizer notes

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.83: full phosphorus (and potash, if soil-test low) applied in furrows at planting
timing_hint: Apply the phosphorus, and the potash if the soil test is low in it, in the furrows below the cane setts at planting.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, sugarcane 'Method of Fertilizer Application'

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.83: 'one half dose of nitrogen...with first irrigation after germination' -- exact DAS not stated in this source
timing_hint: Apply half the nitrogen alongside the cane rows with the first irrigation after germination.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, sugarcane 'Method of Fertilizer Application'

source: PAU POP Kharif 2026 p.83: 'remaining half dose of nitrogen...in May or June' -- exact DAS not stated in this source
timing_hint: Apply the remaining half of the nitrogen alongside the cane rows in May or June.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2026, Vol. 43, sugarcane 'Method of Fertilizer Application'

source: PAU POP Rabi 2025-26 p.36: 'Drill all fertilizers at sowing' (desi and kabuli gram)
timing_hint: Drill all the fertilizer at sowing.
timing_source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Rabi 2025-26, Vol. 42, gram fertilizer table
